ttl.title: TTL & Hop Limit

mtu.description: The largest packet the cellular interface will send without fragmenting.

hl_value.label: Hop limit value
hl_value.consequence: The IPv6 equivalent. Set both unless you know the client is single-stack.

mtu_toggle.label: Override the MTU
mtu_toggle.consequence: Off sets the cellular interface back to the default of 1500.

mtu_value.label: MTU value
mtu_value.consequence: {{min}}–{{max}}. Below roughly 1400 can break path-MTU discovery on sites that drop ICMP.

qmanager.title: About QManager
qmanager.note: Hey there! Rus here. QManager is the latest iteration of QuecManager, built with a newer and more reliable approach compared to its predecessor — while still combining technical settings for advanced users with a simplified UI for those just getting started. Special thanks to iamromulan, clndwhr, and Wutang Clan!
